dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}! I made it!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: This place is fascinating! It's perfect for Windtrace.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: It's a lot different from what I'm used to.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there something you don't like?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no! That's not what I meant at all!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Being here... It's just a new sensation, that's all!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I've never been somewhere so amazing! I'm so excited, my heart feels like it's beating a mile a minute!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess this place is pretty big...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Definitely... The size is only part of it, though. What's really impressive is what you've done with the place!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I never get lost in the mountains back home, and that's a big area, too.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: But, as I was exploring this place just now, I really had to pay attention, or I never would have found my way back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's okay. I would come and save you!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Hehe, really?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Then, if you hear the frantic ringing of a silver bell, come find me, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Sure! Then, let's talk about... Ooh! How you're feeling right now!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's it! Tell me what you're thinking in this exact moment!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's kind of sudden... I'm not sure what to say...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: That's exactly my point!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if you've noticed, but it feels like you know me a lot better than I know you.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Think about it — we've talked about my hobbies, my problems, all the embarrassing things I've done...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: But, when it comes to you, I know about your past achievements and your future goals, but that's it.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Not that that's a bad thing, it's just... the past and future are only part of the story...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: And all too often in life, people end up neglecting the here and now.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: For instance, people talk about how you never stop. No matter how tough your journey gets, you just grit your teeth and keep going.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Sure, it means you accomplish a huge amount each day. But it also means that you don't get to stop and rest, even when you feel tired...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I guess what I'm getting at is... Is this what you really want in life? It feels like you're busier than a swallow trying to build a nest.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Huh. Wow, I didn't expect that answer!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: I thought you were going to break down and tell me how tired you are.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Haha, I'm glad! That's all I could hope for! It means you're not short on energy, at least!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: I suppose there's no need for me to worry. Let me ask you this, then...

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Do you ever get to nap or sleep in? Oh, and can your hands do entirely different tasks at the same time?

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Silver needs to be hammered time and again for it to shine, but humans don't work that way! If you're tired, just rest!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Now, I want you to close your eyes. Tell me the first thing that comes to your mind, and we'll go do it!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Well? Was it eating a delicious meal? Or doing some sight-seeing?

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: What!? You thought about all the unfinished commissions in your Adventurer Handbook!?

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: *sigh*... Well, if that's what it takes to get you to rest...

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Alright, I'll go with you. But, in two days, okay?

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: I don't want to go right now, and I should respect how I feel in the moment, right? Now, all you need to do is follow my example.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Actually, can I add an urgent commission to your handbook? "Spend the next two days relaxing with Lan Yan"... There. Even if you're not tired, I certainly am...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I was just thinking about what you could add to this place...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh? Is there something I'm missing?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Well... I wanted to make some rattan furniture for you, but it looks like you have everything covered around here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah! They're all things from my collection, or things I made myself.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Hehe, I can tell they mean a lot to you. All of these pieces are in great shape! You must really cherish them.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Wait, I've got it!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I'll make rattan covers for your furniture. Oh, and some of the more fragile trinkets around here, too! You'll never have to worry about scratches again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds like a lot of work!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: It's no trouble at all! Don't forget, I'm a member of the Artisans Association. It's what I do! And, I enjoy it!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Besides, I'm the one imposing upon your hospitality. It's the least I can do!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: If you like the idea, then I'll get started right away. If you have reservations... just let me know!

choices.text: I'd love nothing more than to add Madame Lan's works to my collection!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Haha, you flatter me! To have such an eminent figure praise my work... The honor is all mine!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Alright, I humored you, so we can drop the formalities, right?

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Then, let me say this...

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Once the covers are ready, don't feel like you need to store them away for safe-keeping. Use them to your heart's content!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Oh, and promise me you won't cover them with any cloth to try and protect them...

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: *sigh*... I barely remember what our own furniture looks like... Every day, it's like my mom adds another layer of cloth...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, you have my word!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Great! Then I'll get started right away. Measurements first!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How can I help?

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Actually, there is something I need from you...

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Tell me the stories behind all these items! I'm dying to know!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Oh, that's what you're worried about?

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: All rattan strands are washed, sun-dried, shaped, and planed before using, and that doesn't even touch on the steaming, oiling, or coloring processes...

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Point being, it's not an issue! Not to brag or anything, but my rattan crafts are extremely durable! You don't have to worry about moisture or insects!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Even if they get damaged — and that's a big if — I can always fix them. Unless, you're saying you don't trust my skills...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Lan Yan.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Morning! Did you sleep well?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Huh, it looks like you could use a nap.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Lan Yan.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Night! Don't let me keep you!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I'm gonna stay up and finish this novel — only two pages to go. A mysterious entity under the bed just grabbed the main character by the foot...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Wow, I never thought I'd get to take a walk down the country lanes while I'm here! Did you set all this up just for me?

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Fresh fruit and vegetables, groceries, and... what's that over there? I feel spoiled for choice! Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I gotta walk down this street and take this all in. Come on! Keep up!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Silverware needs to be kept in clean, dry conditions, just like books. At home, we actually keep all our silver in a study room just like this.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: You shouldn't stack silver, because sometimes it can be a little soft and malleable. The best way to store it is to wrap it up in cloth and put it on a bookshelf.

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: That reminds me — I brought some pieces from my collection with me, and they need a lot of care. It's probably time I gave them a clean... do you wanna see them?
